West Bengal Assembly to consider Uniform Civil Code Bill

The West Bengal Assembly is set to consider a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) Bill, with the ruling BJP government planning to table it. The bill aims to establish a uniform legal framework for civil matters like marriage, divorce, inheritance, and adoption, applicable to all religions. The move is anticipated to spark debate and face challenges from opposition parties within the assembly.
